tags: Heavy Duty 3/4 Inch Offset Pivot Sets

text.description_html:
Rixon 195 Heavy Duty Door Pivot Set

These Rixon manufactured jamb mounted 3/4" offset pivots are engineered for durability on heavy doors weighing up to 450 pounds. Set includes top pivot, and bottom pivots with installation hardware.

The bottom pivot is mortised into side door jamb (Jamb Mounted) and the doors bottom. Top pivot is mortised into the header and top of the door.

Specifications: for RIX 0195 Door Pivot Set

  • Offset: 3/4"
  • Door Weight: Up to 450 lbs
  • Interior or Exterior Door Size: Up to 5' 0" x 7' 5"
  • 3/16" vertical arm adjustment after installation
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Handed - Must specify left hand door or right hand door when ordering
  • ABH 0195 Installation Instructions (PDF)
  • ABH 0195 Installation Template (PDF)

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this pivot hinge:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
